instructions: Copy this file to a local environment.json. Fill lake and python3 if they are not on PATH. Do not write private worktree or cache paths into the API files under examples/platform-increment. Run bind-environment.py as a separate step before run-token0-example.py. solc and evm are not required to run the Lean library example; bind them only to replay the accepted P16 source archive.

notes.lake: Path to the lake executable, or null to discover from PATH during bind-environment.py. Invocation must be: lake env lean, from the repository lean/ directory, so the toolchain file selects 4.33.0-rc2.
notes.lean: Optional. The binder records the lake-env Lean, not a default PATH lean that may be a different version.
notes.solc: Optional. Accepted P16 compiler identity is solc 0.7.6, sha256 bd69ea85427bf2f4da74cb426ad951dd78db9dfdd01d791208eccc2d4958a6bb. Prefer the versioned archive review/semantic-kernel/program-execution-20260908/p16-source-candidate-r6.tar.gz over a private cache path.
notes.evm: Optional. Accepted P16 evm sha256 d298ce2c811de089d650ed4f9535c0c58efc72e7adee9b61a40b6c10cc26fb5c. Not required for the Lean example.
